title: Multi-Warehouse Inventory with Low-Stock Alerts
goal: Add warehouses/inventory/stock_alerts tables; per-warehouse inventory/reserve APIs; admin grid with color-coded low-stock indicators and bulk threshold updates; low-stock alert trigger; knowledge-capture metric events.
inScope: stock_alerts table and open alerts API
reserve inventory API with advisory lock
threshold propose/decision APIs with bulk updates
apiEndpoints: GET /api/inventory?page=&page_size=&product_id= — paginated grid or single product
POST /api/inventory/reserve — reserve stock with advisory lock
(existing) database migrations for warehouses, inventory, stock_alerts tables

migrations.name: Version-1.0.1.ts
migrations.action: create inventory table + indexes + unique constraint

migrations.name: Version-1.0.3.ts
migrations.action: add unique index on stock_alerts(product_id, warehouse_id)

commands: live API tests against running app: create warehouse, adjust stock, propose/approve threshold, reserve cross-below-threshold, retrieve alerts, concurrent reserve stress test
validation.results: All 27 unit tests pass; 4 metrics tests pass; compile + build pass; live reservation reduced stock 5→4, oversized reservation returned 400, concurrent reserves left stock at 0 with one success and one insufficient response.

risks.assumption: Advisory lock serializes concurrent inventory adjustments so stock never goes negative; tested under real concurrency but not extended to 3-5 simultaneous requests on a fresh DB.
risks.verify: Run 5-way concurrent reserve tests with fresh stock before production rollout.

risks.assumption: Single stock_alerts row per (product, warehouse) stores the threshold + current alert state; intended as config, not an event log.
risks.verify: Confirm PBI scope intends this, not a multi-row crossing history. If multi-row is required, change stock_alerts schema.

risks.assumption: min_threshold always present and valid when crossedBelowThreshold runs; rows guarded by length check, NULL would compare as 0.
risks.verify: Insert stock_alerts row with NULL min_threshold, confirm no crash and correct behavior.

risks.assumption: Warehouse is_active cascades delete inventory rows on warehouse deletion; unintended loss if applied outside PBI scope.
risks.verify: Mark warehouse inactive, confirm no loss, then activate back.

risks.assumption: positiveInteger rejects qty=0 (correct strictness); callers needing no-op reserves must reserve 1 then immediately release.
risks.verify: Hit reserve qty=0 through each API to confirm 400.

learningCandidates.claim: pg_advisory_xact_lock must be acquired inside a transaction for per-(product,warehouse) serialization; holding it outside fails because the connection is returned to the pool.
learningCandidates.evidence: smoke test confirmed correct behavior; debug trace showed lock needed transaction-scoped
learningCandidates.uncertainty: Not yet extended to 5-way concurrent loads.
learningCandidates.reuse: PBI-1 reservation pattern shares same insight.

learningCandidates.claim: FOR UPDATE OF i locks only the inventory row on those tables that have it, avoiding deadlock with shared product lock from other modules.
learningCandidates.uncertainty: May interact poorly with checkout addCartItem on same (product,warehouse).
learningCandidates.reuse: Checkout module may also benefit from lock migration.
